title: Deploy provider application and create offer
description: Deploy 'haproxy' as 'provider-app' in 'lab-cmr-provider' and offer 'provider-app:reverseproxy' as 'proxy-offer'.

title: Deploy consumer and integrate cross-model offer
description: Deploy 'haproxy' as 'consumer-app' in 'lab-cmr-consumer' and integrate 'consumer-app:website' with 'lab-cmr-provider.proxy-offer'.
